note: Keys are derived by docs/spikes/plan-06/q6_comprehension_keys.ts from the run files named in derived_from. Never edit by hand; rerun the script.
answer_format: A JSON object mapping question id to a string: an id, a number, or one option letter.

questions.text: Which of the three recommended recipes cools the roof the most? Give its identifier (for example SP-000).
By how many kelvin does that recipe lower the peak surface temperature compared with bare aluminium (scenario mean)? Give one number with one decimal.
Is the cooling number on the page a measurement?

options.A: Yes, measured on coated aluminium samples
options.C: No, it is a prediction of a model for the freshly applied coating, not a measurement
options.D: Yes, measured on real roofs in Indonesia

questions.text: What does the label PROXY mean next to a number?

options.A: A relative ranking index, not a measurement and not a probability
options.B: A calibrated probability that the coating will fail
options.C: A value measured by a proxy instrument
options.D: A value copied from the manufacturer's datasheet

questions.text: On the balanced budget curve, at what cost (relative units, not rupiah) does paying more stop buying much, the knee of the curve? Give one number with two decimals.
Which of the five Indonesian sites benefits most from the cooling-pick recipe? Give the site name.
Which of these does the report say it does not model or does not know?

options.C: Scattering of light by the pigments
options.D: Weathering, ageing and adhesion of the coating

questions.text: What does the report recommend as the next step for the cooling pick?

options.B: Make small coated samples and test them in a laboratory
options.C: Publish the numbers as validated results
